channel.title: Indian Quantum Lab Blog
channel.description: Deep dives into quantum computing concepts, algorithms, research breakthroughs, and practical tutorials from India's open quantum education platform.

item.title: Introduction to Qubits: Beyond Classical Bits
item.description: Unlike classical bits that exist as 0 or 1, qubits can exist in superposition — a fundamental property that enables quantum parallelism and exponential speedup in specific computations.

item.title: Understanding the Hadamard Gate
item.description: The Hadamard gate is the workhorse of quantum computing. Learn how this simple 2x2 matrix creates perfect superposition and enables quantum algorithms to explore multiple paths simultaneously.

item.title: Quantum Entanglement Explained Simply
item.description: Einstein called it "spooky action at a distance." Entanglement links qubits so that measuring one instantly determines the other, regardless of distance — enabling quantum teleportation and secure communication.

item.title: Grover's Search Algorithm: A Visual Guide
item.description: Grover's algorithm finds a marked item in an unsorted database of N items using only √N queries — a quadratic speedup over classical search. Learn how amplitude amplification makes this possible.

item.title: Shor's Algorithm and the Future of RSA Encryption
item.description: Shor's algorithm can factor large integers exponentially faster than classical methods, threatening RSA encryption. Learn the math behind it and why post-quantum cryptography is essential.
